signal.claim: e.l.f. launched its first-ever holiday campaign, a 60-second stop-motion spot narrated by Alan Cumming. It runs on digital and social platforms and in a takeover of the TV sections at Best Buy and Target.
signal.quote: The holiday magic will extend beyond the screen and into the shopping aisle in a takeover of the TV sections of Best Buy and Target stores throughout the holiday gift-giving season.
signal.touchpoint: holiday campaign Best Buy and Target TV section takeover

signal.claim: e.l.f. Cosmetics added Sanrio's Kuromi to its Glow Up! Roblox experience, with new content planned through the holiday season.
signal.quote: Glow Up! is the no. 1 branded makeup game on Roblox, with more than 12 million visits since launch.

signal.claim: e.l.f. launched "Express your e.l.f.", its first virtual styling experience on the ZEPETO avatar platform, where players dress avatars in e.l.f.-designed looks and share photos and videos to the ZEPETO feed.
signal.quote: Players can also show off their e.l.f. looks by snapping photos and videos against custom e.l.f. backgrounds and sharing them directly to the ZEPETO feed.

signal.claim: e.l.f.'s first-ever holiday campaign, "Made to Stand Out", debuted Nov 2 on e.l.f. digital and social platforms and extends into Best Buy and Target TV aisles.
signal.quote: The 60-second "e.l.f. Made to Stand Out" spot debuts November 2, 2026, across e.l.f. digital and social platforms.
signal.touchpoint: holiday campaign spot on digital and social platforms

signal.claim: e.l.f. Cosmetics runs a live Beauty Squad loyalty program and mobile app where members earn points on retailer purchases by uploading receipts, giving the brand first-party data on sales outside its own site.
signal.quote: If you purchase e.l.f. products at retail partners like Target, Ulta, Walmart, or other authorized stores - simply upload your receipt after purchasing any e.l.f. SKIN or cosmetic item to receive points
signal.touchpoint: Beauty Squad loyalty program and mobile app

signal.claim: On 2026-11-12, e.l.f. Beauty launched "Dial 0 for Zero Distance", a tap-to-dial and phone line to the CEO tied to the impact report, with live call-in and town-hall sessions.
signal.quote: Right now, the community can call or click a tap-to-dial online experience to learn more from Amin about e.l.f. Beauty's purpose platform and leave a voicemail
signal.touchpoint: Dial 0 for Zero Distance tap-to-dial hotline

signal.claim: e.l.f. Cosmetics and e.l.f. SKIN are back at the 2026 NWSL Championship for a second year with the Glow For Glory contest, a March to the Match and a Fan Fest presence streamed on Twitch.
signal.quote: All season long, e.l.f. has activated a connected commerce ecosystem across Amazon, TikTok Live, and social platforms like Glow Up!, e.l.f.'s Roblox makeup experience, converting NWSL moments into real-time sales.
signal.touchpoint: NWSL Championship Fan Fest and Glow For Glory

signal.claim: e.l.f. took its pickle-themed "eyes.lips.fairgrounds." pop-up to the State Fair of Texas on Oct 9–11, following its Minnesota State Fair debut.
signal.quote: In Minnesota, more than 64K people passed through e.l.f.'s activation and the average guest at the e.l.f. activation spent 8 minutes getting to know how the brand shows up as a different kind of company.
signal.touchpoint: State Fair of Texas pop-up activation

signal.claim: e.l.f. renewed as Official Back of Shirt Sponsor of Tottenham Hotspur Women for the 2026-27 season.
signal.quote: Throughout the 2026-2027 season, Tottenham Hotspur Women and e.l.f. will continue to deliver unique experiences, innovative content and community initiatives.

signal.claim: e.l.f. launched e.l.f. POP, its first fragrance and body care line, debuting with a limited-edition holiday Tromsø collection with packaging designed with two Norwegian artists.
signal.quote: e.l.f. partnered with two Norwegian artists to create a holistic, transporting experience across the Tromsø collection's packaging and supporting campaign. Illustrator Esra Røise anchors the collection's visuals across the product line.

signal.claim: Well People (an e.l.f. Beauty brand) launched in more than 500 Sprouts Farmers Market stores and on Sprouts.com, placed in the Beauty & Wellness aisle.
signal.quote: The chain-wide rollout brings Well People to more than 500 Sprouts locations, making clean beauty easy to discover as part of the weekly grocery and wellness shop.
signal.touchpoint: Sprouts Farmers Market Beauty & Wellness aisle

signal.claim: e.l.f. Beauty launched "Dial 0 for Zero Distance," a hotline to the CEO, alongside its fifth impact report, with a phone number, tap-to-dial web link, live call-in on Nov 13 and a public Town Hall on Nov 19.
signal.quote: Right now, the community can call or click a tap-to-dial online experience to learn more from Amin about e.l.f. Beauty's purpose platform and leave a voicemail with feedback on the impact report
